issues.title: Bug - showing force color not role name in RFIs
issues.body:
I'm a White force player, viewing Blue RFIs.

I "Claim" the RFI, and it shows my force color, not my role name:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/135076430-ea9c5af5-a273-4ca3-bc8b-cfee4371620b.png)

Steps to reproduce:http://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=pkskl17ti
* Log in as blue player: http://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=pkskl17tha
* Submit a new RFI
* Login as white player: http://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=pkskl17ti
* "Claim" the new RFI
* The RFI will update, and show my force color, rather than my name.
